name: Amazon SQS
description: Bounded SQS queue and message operations with SigV4, explicit receipt acknowledgements and guarded writes.

permissions.description: HTTPS only to configured SQS endpoint; SigV4 credentials from named secrets. Optional session token via configured reference. Every effect, including receive, requires explicit confirmation and zero retries.

definitions.name: List Queues (SQS)
definitions.documentation: ListQueues: one AWS JSON POST, X-Amz-Target AmazonSQS.ListQueues, SigV4 service sqs. Named secrets SQS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SQS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; optional sessionTokenSecret. QueueUrl must match configured HTTPS endpoint and account/queue path. Conservative 512 KiB message/batch payload, 1 MiB request/result, max 10 batch/messages or 1000 queues, timeout 100..60000 ms; caller follows pagination. Receive never deletes messages; use current ReceiptHandle explicitly.  All operations require $retries=0; uncertain outcomes and partial failures are never replayed. Batch failures expose Id, Code, SenderFault; private provider Message text omitted. FIFO requires MessageGroupId; queue settings determine deduplication requirement. No listener, automatic visibility renewal, automatic acknowledgement or live-provider verification. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/APIReference/API_ListQueues.html

definitions.name: Get Queue Url (SQS)
definitions.documentation: GetQueueUrl: one AWS JSON POST, X-Amz-Target AmazonSQS.GetQueueUrl, SigV4 service sqs. Named secrets SQS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SQS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; optional sessionTokenSecret. QueueUrl must match configured HTTPS endpoint and account/queue path. Conservative 512 KiB message/batch payload, 1 MiB request/result, max 10 batch/messages or 1000 queues, timeout 100..60000 ms; caller follows pagination. Receive never deletes messages; use current ReceiptHandle explicitly.  All operations require $retries=0; uncertain outcomes and partial failures are never replayed. Batch failures expose Id, Code, SenderFault; private provider Message text omitted. FIFO requires MessageGroupId; queue settings determine deduplication requirement. No listener, automatic visibility renewal, automatic acknowledgement or live-provider verification. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/APIReference/API_GetQueueUrl.html

definitions.name: Tag Queue (SQS)
definitions.documentation: TagQueue: one AWS JSON POST, X-Amz-Target AmazonSQS.TagQueue, SigV4 service sqs. Named secrets SQS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SQS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; optional sessionTokenSecret. QueueUrl must match configured HTTPS endpoint and account/queue path. Conservative 512 KiB message/batch payload, 1 MiB request/result, max 10 batch/messages or 1000 queues, timeout 100..60000 ms; caller follows pagination. Receive never deletes messages; use current ReceiptHandle explicitly. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=TAG_QUEUE. All operations require $retries=0; uncertain outcomes and partial failures are never replayed. Batch failures expose Id, Code, SenderFault; private provider Message text omitted. FIFO requires MessageGroupId; queue settings determine deduplication requirement. No listener, automatic visibility renewal, automatic acknowledgement or live-provider verification. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/APIReference/API_TagQueue.html

definitions.name: Send Message Batch (SQS)
definitions.documentation: SendMessageBatch: one AWS JSON POST, X-Amz-Target AmazonSQS.SendMessageBatch, SigV4 service sqs. Named secrets SQS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SQS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; optional sessionTokenSecret. QueueUrl must match configured HTTPS endpoint and account/queue path. Conservative 512 KiB message/batch payload, 1 MiB request/result, max 10 batch/messages or 1000 queues, timeout 100..60000 ms; caller follows pagination. Receive never deletes messages; use current ReceiptHandle explicitly. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=SEND_MESSAGE_BATCH. All operations require $retries=0; uncertain outcomes and partial failures are never replayed. Batch failures expose Id, Code, SenderFault; private provider Message text omitted. FIFO requires MessageGroupId; queue settings determine deduplication requirement. No listener, automatic visibility renewal, automatic acknowledgement or live-provider verification. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/APIReference/API_SendMessageBatch.html

definitions.name: Receive Message (SQS)
definitions.documentation: ReceiveMessage: one AWS JSON POST, X-Amz-Target AmazonSQS.ReceiveMessage, SigV4 service sqs. Named secrets SQS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SQS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; optional sessionTokenSecret. QueueUrl must match configured HTTPS endpoint and account/queue path. Conservative 512 KiB message/batch payload, 1 MiB request/result, max 10 batch/messages or 1000 queues, timeout 100..60000 ms; caller follows pagination. Receive never deletes messages; use current ReceiptHandle explicitly. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=RECEIVE_MESSAGE. All operations require $retries=0; uncertain outcomes and partial failures are never replayed. Batch failures expose Id, Code, SenderFault; private provider Message text omitted. FIFO requires MessageGroupId; queue settings determine deduplication requirement. No listener, automatic visibility renewal, automatic acknowledgement or live-provider verification. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/APIReference/API_ReceiveMessage.html

definitions.name: Delete Message (SQS)
definitions.documentation: DeleteMessage: one AWS JSON POST, X-Amz-Target AmazonSQS.DeleteMessage, SigV4 service sqs. Named secrets SQS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SQS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; optional sessionTokenSecret. QueueUrl must match configured HTTPS endpoint and account/queue path. Conservative 512 KiB message/batch payload, 1 MiB request/result, max 10 batch/messages or 1000 queues, timeout 100..60000 ms; caller follows pagination. Receive never deletes messages; use current ReceiptHandle explicitly. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=DELETE_MESSAGE. All operations require $retries=0; uncertain outcomes and partial failures are never replayed. Batch failures expose Id, Code, SenderFault; private provider Message text omitted. FIFO requires MessageGroupId; queue settings determine deduplication requirement. No listener, automatic visibility renewal, automatic acknowledgement or live-provider verification. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/APIReference/API_DeleteMessage.html

definitions.name: Change Message Visibility Batch (SQS)
definitions.documentation: ChangeMessageVisibilityBatch: one AWS JSON POST, X-Amz-Target AmazonSQS.ChangeMessageVisibilityBatch, SigV4 service sqs. Named secrets SQS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SQS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; optional sessionTokenSecret. QueueUrl must match configured HTTPS endpoint and account/queue path. Conservative 512 KiB message/batch payload, 1 MiB request/result, max 10 batch/messages or 1000 queues, timeout 100..60000 ms; caller follows pagination. Receive never deletes messages; use current ReceiptHandle explicitly. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=CHANGE_MESSAGE_VISIBILITY_BATCH. All operations require $retries=0; uncertain outcomes and partial failures are never replayed. Batch failures expose Id, Code, SenderFault; private provider Message text omitted. FIFO requires MessageGroupId; queue settings determine deduplication requirement. No listener, automatic visibility renewal, automatic acknowledgement or live-provider verification. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/APIReference/API_ChangeMessageVisibilityBatch.html

definitions.name: Add Permission (SQS)
definitions.documentation: AddPermission: one AWS JSON POST, X-Amz-Target AmazonSQS.AddPermission, SigV4 service sqs. Named secrets SQS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SQS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; optional sessionTokenSecret. QueueUrl must match configured HTTPS endpoint and account/queue path. Conservative 512 KiB message/batch payload, 1 MiB request/result, max 10 batch/messages or 1000 queues, timeout 100..60000 ms; caller follows pagination. Receive never deletes messages; use current ReceiptHandle explicitly. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=ADD_PERMISSION. All operations require $retries=0; uncertain outcomes and partial failures are never replayed. Batch failures expose Id, Code, SenderFault; private provider Message text omitted. FIFO requires MessageGroupId; queue settings determine deduplication requirement. No listener, automatic visibility renewal, automatic acknowledgement or live-provider verification. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/APIReference/API_AddPermission.html

definitions.name: Remove Permission (SQS)
definitions.documentation: RemovePermission: one AWS JSON POST, X-Amz-Target AmazonSQS.RemovePermission, SigV4 service sqs. Named secrets SQS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SQS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; optional sessionTokenSecret. QueueUrl must match configured HTTPS endpoint and account/queue path. Conservative 512 KiB message/batch payload, 1 MiB request/result, max 10 batch/messages or 1000 queues, timeout 100..60000 ms; caller follows pagination. Receive never deletes messages; use current ReceiptHandle explicitly. Requires confirmWrites=true, confirmation=REMOVE_PERMISSION. All operations require $retries=0; uncertain outcomes and partial failures are never replayed. Batch failures expose Id, Code, SenderFault; private provider Message text omitted. FIFO requires MessageGroupId; queue settings determine deduplication requirement. No listener, automatic visibility renewal, automatic acknowledgement or live-provider verification. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/APIReference/API_RemovePermission.html

definitions.name: List Dead Letter Source Queues (SQS)
definitions.documentation: ListDeadLetterSourceQueues: one AWS JSON POST, X-Amz-Target AmazonSQS.ListDeadLetterSourceQueues, SigV4 service sqs. Named secrets SQS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/SQS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; optional sessionTokenSecret. QueueUrl must match configured HTTPS endpoint and account/queue path. Conservative 512 KiB message/batch payload, 1 MiB request/result, max 10 batch/messages or 1000 queues, timeout 100..60000 ms; caller follows pagination. Receive never deletes messages; use current ReceiptHandle explicitly.  All operations require $retries=0; uncertain outcomes and partial failures are never replayed. Batch failures expose Id, Code, SenderFault; private provider Message text omitted. FIFO requires MessageGroupId; queue settings determine deduplication requirement. No listener, automatic visibility renewal, automatic acknowledgement or live-provider verification. Source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSSimpleQueueService/latest/APIReference/API_ListDeadLetterSourceQueues.html
